assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a true seamless 360 by 180 degree equirectangular environment panorama for an interactive Street View woodland scene. Output exactly 2:1, preferably 3840x1920. Image 1 is the primary environment reference and camera location: beside irregular mossy grey cobblestones, facing the muddy path with willow shrubs left, dense green and dead brown cattails right, fallen thin branches left. Images 2 and 3 are nearby views for spatial context only. Expand image 1's world in ALL directions into one spherical panorama from that same standing point, preserve recognisable path, stone cluster, branches, reeds and cloudy daylight. Center longitude (middle of image) looks forward down the muddy path; right quarter looks directly into cattails, left quarter into fallen branches and green willow bushes; wrap edges show continuation of the cobbled trail behind the viewer leading back into ordinary damp woodland. Horizon exactly halfway vertically. Top edge is the zenith with grey overcast sky and canopy, bottom edge nadir of mossy stones and dirt at camera feet. Correct lat-long spherical mapping, no rectangular perspective photo pasted in, no fisheye circle, no grids or split panels. Left and right edges must meet continuously with matching trees and ground. Realistic casual phone panorama, unpolished framing, subdued overcast light, irregular muddy soil and unvarnished wood, no dramatic cinema, no CGI, no vignette, no people, no text, arrows, UI or watermarks. All content is an AI environment illustration, not a documented natural location.
